description: OBLIGACIONES DE HACER 4G - GOBERNACIÓN DE BOYACÁ is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Boyacá, Boyacá. Se brinda a la ciudadanía en general del departamento de Boyacá información sobre el avance de la ampliación de cobertura móvil en el departamento de Boyacá adelantado por las empresas prestadoras de servicio de telefonía, de acuerdo a lo establecido en los acuerdos referentes al uso de espectro radioeléctrico. Coverage: Gobernación de Boyacá, Boyacá. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Boyacá, Boyacá. Its tags are 4g. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2024-10-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
